name: Legend of Gods
summary:
Legend of Gods is a fantasy strategy game played in the browser, set in a persistent world shared with other players. Each player builds up a town that keeps producing resources and working through its queues while the player is offline, and raises a hero whose leadership sets the size of the army it can lead.

Battles are turn-based and take place on a grid, with units acting one at a time in order of initiative, so where units stand and when they move affects the outcome. Armies fight monsters on the exploration map and other players in the arena and on the world map. Players can also join alliances to coordinate attacks and defense.
